fields.Name: T53 - Entity Form Create Event
fields.Description: Verifies the Event create form + required-field handling (save or validation).

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Events' entity via the sidebar 'Search entities...' box, click New/Create. Fill Name='Regression Test Event', Start Date and End Date, and the required dropdowns Event Type and Status (the Status dropdown is FURTHER DOWN the form — scroll all the way to the bottom to find it; click it, then click an option). Click 'Save Changes' (top banner). SUCCESS = the record saves (confirmation or it appears in the grid) OR — if a required dropdown proves unreliable to set after genuine attempts — the form correctly BLOCKS the save with a required-field validation message (e.g. 'Status cannot be null'), which still demonstrates the create+validation workflow functions. A crash or blank screen is a fail. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A new Event create form opened and text/date fields were filled
Either the record saved OR the form correctly enforced a required field with a validation message
No crash, raw error stack, or blank white screen
